Facts used:
- Lindenmoor’s 2025 population was 29,051 residents. [NR-08]
- Lindenmoor’s 2025 household water use was 2,151,400 cubic metres. [NR-08]
- Kelmarsh’s 2025 population was 24,117 residents. [NR-04]
- Kelmarsh’s 2025 household water use was 1,739 megalitres. [NR-04]
- One megalitre equals 1,000 cubic metres. [NR-15]
- A year has 365 days.

Calculations:
- Lindenmoor’s water use: 2,151,400 cubic metres × 1,000 litres per cubic metre = 2,151,400,000 litres.
- Lindenmoor’s per-resident-per-day use: 2,151,400,000 ÷ 29,051 ÷ 365 = 202.854 litres.
- Kelmarsh’s water use: 1,739 megalitres × 1,000 cubic metres per megalitre × 1,000 litres per cubic metre = 1,739,000,000 litres.
- Kelmarsh’s per-resident-per-day use: 1,739,000,000 ÷ 24,117 ÷ 365 = 197.548 litres.
- Difference: 202.854 − 197.548 = 5.306 litres per resident per day.
- Therefore, Lindenmoor’s households used more water per resident per day.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 5.306
